whyChooseUs.title: Certified — with a real warranty
whyChooseUs.body: All installers are 3M-certified and projects use 3M MCS-warranty materials. If a wrap fails due to equipment, ink or material, it gets fixed — guaranteed.

whyChooseUs.title: Since 1978
whyChooseUs.body: Decades specializing in vehicle wraps and large-format graphics, with a BBB A+ rating and accreditation since 2008.

whyChooseUs.title: Everything under one roof
whyChooseUs.body: A full in-house art department plus certified installation — design, print and install in our 6,000 sq ft heated/cooled facility or on the road at your location.

whyChooseUs.title: Built for any size job
whyChooseUs.body: From a single color-change to a fleet of 500, on vehicles up to 14′ high and 53′ long. No project is too big or too small.

whyChooseUs.title: Premium materials only
whyChooseUs.body: Eco-friendly, high-quality vinyl, ink and lamination for a depth of color and durability that holds up — some wraps show no fade after five years.

whyChooseUs.title: Local, reachable and trusted
whyChooseUs.body: A real Kenilworth shop you can visit, owned and run by Mario Boccongelli, serving Union County and the wider NJ / NY metro.
